title: Two tables
blurb: Two real meetings in one room, a phone on each table. Each phone hears its own table, and the other one more quietly. Which words belong to which conversation?
licence: AMI Meeting Corpus, CC BY 4.0 (https://groups.inf.ed.ac.uk/ami/corpus/license.shtml). Excerpts cut, mixed and loudness-normalised for this scene; each channel adds the other table at -12 dB.
